prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production pixel-art furniture sprite atlas for Agent Office, an original office dashboard game.
Create one BRAND NEW square transparent PNG containing exactly FOUR independent office furniture sprites in a regular TWO by TWO equal-quadrant grid. One complete centered object per quadrant, at least 15 percent empty transparent padding all around, no overlap between quadrants. All objects viewed from the same shallow elevated front angle, with their front edges horizontal, suitable for a top-down 2D office scene. Crisp chunky pixel-art clusters, dark navy outlines, walnut/cream/sage/slate palette, subdued highlights, no noisy texture or painterly gradients. Designed to remain clear at small game sizes.

TOP LEFT: A single warm WALNUT DESKTOP SLAB and its slim front apron ONLY. It is a wide, shallow horizontal desk top, warm brown upper face, dark walnut front edge/apron, squared softened corners. Its total silhouette is roughly 40 wide by 14 high logical pixels. View from slightly above so the upper slab face is visible as a shallow trapezoid with horizontal front edge. Crucially NO LEGS, NO SUPPORTS, NO CHAIR, NO MONITOR, NO BOOKS, NO PLANT, and no accessories. It will be layered over existing game legs later.

TOP RIGHT: A single SLATE AND CREAM DESKTOP SLAB and slim front apron ONLY. Exactly the same dimensions, shallow elevated front camera and overall 40 by 14 silhouette as top left. Muted slate blue upper surface, warm cream front apron with a thin navy lower edge. No legs or supports, chair, monitor or accessories.

BOTTOM LEFT: A compact ACOUSTIC FOCUS BOOTH, approximately 30 wide by 38 high logical pixels. One small freestanding office privacy pod with a muted sage outer frame, cream top trim and side panels, deep dark navy recessed open front doorway, muted sage acoustic wall panels visible inside. Clear empty doorway wide enough for one character; no door handle across the opening, no figure, no furniture inside. Simple professional form, tall upright object. The interior can be dark and visually recessed; only the surrounding exterior background is transparent. The entire booth is isolated without an outside floor slab.

BOTTOM RIGHT: A compact TWO-DRAWER FILING CABINET, approximately 22 wide by 26 high logical pixels. Warm cream drawer fronts with small simple navy horizontal pull handles, walnut sides and top, two short navy feet, restrained shading. Exactly two drawers, no books or accessories on top.

Constraints: EXACT 2 by 2 atlas, exactly these four objects, each fits entirely inside its own equal quadrant with generous gaps. Same understated pixel-art style and camera throughout. Full clean object silhouettes, no cropping. Genuinely transparent surrounding background and gaps, no fake checkerboard, no scenery, no floor, no ground shadows, no outer glow, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no logo, no watermark. All artwork is original and may be included in a public open-source game. Do not copy existing third-party sprite packs.
